title: Let the Beloved's way please you
summary: The shabad does not merely endure the Friend's actions; it lets them become pleasing. Consent deepens when the heart stops treating the Beloved's way as a wound.
takeaway: Let the Friend's way become dearer than the mind's preferred outcome.
lifeApplication: Before the next complaint takes shape, soften the mouth. Ask whether this resistance is protecting love or only protecting preference.

source.shortMeaning: The heart learns to find the Friend's actions pleasing, not only unavoidable.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next complaint, soften the mouth and let the Beloved's way outrank preference.
